title: Motion Sickness Remedy
paragraphs: From the next day onward, Father and the others began their training.
“Ugh… is it morning already?”
Ren and Itsuki sluggishly got up, looking gloomy.

“It is. What should we do for breakfast? Should we eat at the tavern attached to the inn? Or should we reheat the leftover meat and wild vegetables from yesterday by the river? We also have the smoked meat from yesterday.”
That was something I made. Under Father’s supervision, so it’s guaranteed to be delicious.
“Ah, you mean that smoked meat you made using that tasteless Phalaris Bull…”
“At least it’s not human meat…”
“Well, money isn’t an issue, so why not just order something from the tavern?”
At that moment, Éclair paused and then made a suggestion to Ren and Itsuki.
“The problem is that a lot of Silvelt’s cuisine has strong, unique flavors. I wonder if Amaki-dono and Kawasumi-dono will be able to handle it…”
“We should just try it and see, right? I mean, we’re in another world, so we should be curious about its food. Don’t you think?”
“Yeah. Since we’ve come all this way, we might as well experience it.”
“That’s true. I’d like to try it too.”
“However, there are foods that may be harmless to demi-humans but poisonous to humans. We need to be cautious.”
Now that I think about it, in the past, Father had used his keen eye to avoid certain dishes. In that case, I shall step forward!
“Then allow me to inspect the food!”
“Alright, let’s rely on Motoyasu-kun, then. Once I eat it, I should be able to recreate it to some extent.”
“You can do something that skillful?”
“You can’t?”

Father responded to Ren’s question with another question. A foolish inquiry indeed. When it comes to cooking, Father can do just about anything. Even if it’s a dish he’s never tasted before, I’m sure he can recreate it after just one try. He’s an unconscious genius in that regard.
“I mean… I’ve never really cooked before, so I wouldn’t know.”
“Me neither…”

It seems Ren and Itsuki have no experience with cooking for themselves. I, on the other hand, have some experience, but Filo-tan always said Father’s food was tastier than mine, so I can’t compete with his skills.
“Well, you’ll get used to it over time. I’ll also think about how we can adjust the flavors to suit our tastes.”
“Ah… right.”
“That makes sense.”
Father seemed to be deep in thought for a moment.
“Judging by how things went yesterday, it might be best to skip breakfast.”
“Why is that?”
Oh? What’s this about? Ren and Itsuki, looking irritated by their empty stomachs, turned to face him.
“Well, you both looked pretty nauseous after riding on Yuki-chan and the others yesterday. If you eat breakfast now, you might end up throwing it all up.”
“Ugh…”
Ren and Itsuki hesitated and turned to look at me. Is there some kind of problem with Filolials?
“W-We don’t have to ride them, right? We can just walk. At worst, we can go on a hunting spree within the shared experience range to make up for the time.”
“Y-Yeah, that works.”
“That’s true, but eventually, you’ll have to get used to it.”
One day, they must adapt to the dreamlike sensation of riding a Filolial. Traveling from Silvelt to Faubrey is about the same distance as traveling across Melromarc.
“Even when riding in a shared carriage, the ride isn’t exactly comfortable, right, Éclair?”
“While it’s rare for people to faint from motion sickness, I have heard of passengers feeling unwell.”
“It’s another world, after all. Shouldn’t you guys just get used to it?”
“W-Well, that’s…”
“I have an idea! How about we let Motoyasu go to Faubrey ahead of us while we stay here and level up? He can bring back a portal for us!”
Do they really hate riding Filolials that much?
“I wouldn’t say it’s a bad plan.”
“It’s not a bad idea, but if Ren and Itsuki stay in this country for too long and people find out who they really are, won’t that be dangerous?”
“Then why not wait in another country instead? Motoyasu, do you have any suggestions?”
“There’s a portal leading to the country where the Phoenix is sealed.”
“That place, huh?”
“Let’s go with that, then!”
At their current level, Ren and Itsuki probably wouldn’t be able to unseal the Phoenix. Still, I have some concerns. And to be frank…
“Ren and Itsuki, you’re just running away.”
When I muttered that, Ren and Itsuki frowned slightly, looking annoyed.
“What did you say?”
“Yeah. When have we ever run away?”
“You’re trying to find ways to avoid riding Filolials just because you dislike it. Doesn’t that count as running away?”
Éclair drove the point home.
“Honestly, it’s a little worrying whether you guys can actually save the world like this.”
“We just want to act efficiently.”
“Exactly! You only say that because you don’t know what it feels like to ride them!”
Well, Éclair did turn pale after riding with me… Just as I was thinking that, Father stepped in. It seems like Ren and Itsuki have a tendency to take the easy route.
“Alright, alright… maybe it really is an awful ride. But I’m against the idea of letting Motoyasu go and retrieve the portal for us.”
“Why?”
“Ren, Itsuki… we were being used. All because we didn’t know anything. If we just follow Motoyasu’s lead without thinking, we might get caught up in another conspiracy.”
“Are you saying you don’t trust Motoyasu?”
“No, no. But we need to see the world for ourselves on the way to Faubrey. You get it, right, Ren? We need something to believe in.”
Ren had struggled with unlocking his weapon enhancements. He likely understood the point Father was making.
“That’s why it’s a good idea to gather information from the different countries we pass through, not just Silvelt.”
“Like Journey to the West?”

“Yeah, something like that. In the story, you might wonder why Sun Wukong didn’t just fly to India on his cloud, but there was a reason for the journey itself, right? I’m not saying we need to copy that exactly, but it’s important to avoid being manipulated by those in power.”
“Then if that happens, can’t we just have Motoyasu loop back and explain everything again?”
“Hahaha.”
I personally don’t mind, but… are you really okay with that? Father responded to Ren with a slightly exasperated expression.
“Hey… that wouldn’t be you making the decision, Ren. It’d be the next Ren. Are you really fine with that?”
“Ugh…”
“I might end up looping again, but I don’t want to waste the experiences I’ve gained so far.”
Father’s words carried weight. He’s the type to put in a tremendous amount of effort. If it weren’t for the Fathers from the past loops, I would have had a much harder time.

“Of course, I won’t lie—I do want to see more of this world. And yeah, I know I can say that easily because I don’t get motion sickness. But if we’re going to fight for this world, we can’t just rely on others. We need to overcome our struggles.”
At that, Éclair started clapping.
“That’s a noble mindset. I’ll accompany you today as well. I also believe that taking one step at a time holds meaning.”
“Motoyasu-kun, how long does it usually take to get used to riding Sakura?”
“Judging by the trends among Father’s past allies, three days at most.”

By the third day, even Keel could ride Sakura without getting sick. Father was even reading books in that situation. By the end, he was even doing delicate tasks while riding! Despite the intense and wild shaking! Truly remarkable.
“See? If you push through for just that long, you’ll stop noticing it. So why not give it a shot?”
“I hate wasting time. But…”
“Besides, don’t you think fighting while riding a horse or a Filolial would look really cool?”
Father’s words made Ren hesitate. The same went for Itsuki.
“Still, though…”
“Oh, and Ren, Itsuki. What do you think will happen if we let Motoyasu go to Faubrey ahead of us?”
“Ah…”
“Oh, right! If we leave it to Motoyasu, who knows what he might do?!”
For some reason, Ren and Itsuki looked at me and nodded firmly.

…What is that supposed to mean? Oh well. Unnecessary people will simply disappear from this world. Just like that Crimson Swine, I’m looking forward to erasing Takt. This time, I’ll start by taking out his Dragon Emperor. As I entertained those thoughts, a grin formed on my lips. Ren and Itsuki grimaced in response.
“By the time we get there, Faubrey might not even exist anymore.”
“Exactly. And even if I went along, I don’t think I could stop him on my own.”
Father’s words made Ren and Itsuki let out deep sighs.
“Sigh… fine. It would be a waste to not make use of that agility.”
“It’ll ultimately be invaluable for tracking down monsters.”
“Yeah, there’s no way we could keep up on foot. We wouldn’t be losing anything.”
“…So what’s the plan, then?”
“Maybe a packed lunch? I’ll borrow the tavern’s kitchen and make some food. Once you guys level up a bit, we can take breaks, eat, and then walk back. How does that sound?”
A brilliant idea. I believe the Father from the first world did something similar.
“Splendid. And if you really can’t handle the motion sickness, I can use my spear to craft a powerful anti-nausea remedy.”
“‘Say that sooner!’”

Oh? Ren and Itsuki yelled at me. In the end, considering the materials they could gather and the combat experience they’d gain along the way, Ren and Itsuki accepted Father’s plan. As expected of Father.
